old_caption: The video showcases a mesmerizing display of numerous diamonds floating against a stark black background. Each diamond is intricately cut, reflecting light in various directions, creating a dazzling array of sparkles and reflections. The diamonds vary in size and shape, from round brilliant cuts to more complex facets, adding depth and dimension to the scene. As they drift, some diamonds exhibit a slow drift or gentle rotation, enhancing their brilliance. The overall effect is one of elegance and luxury, with the diamonds' luminous quality drawing the viewer's eye. There are no other objects or characters present, focusing entirely on the beauty and allure of the diamonds themselves.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a mesmerizing display of numerous diamonds falling against a stark black background. Each diamond is intricately cut, reflecting light in various directions, creating a dazzling array of sparkles and reflections. The diamonds vary in size and shape, from round brilliant cuts to more complex facets, adding depth and dimension to the scene. As they descend, some diamonds rotate slightly, enhancing their brilliance and making them appear almost alive. The overall effect is one of elegance and luxury, with the diamonds' luminous quality drawing the viewer's eye and creating a sense of wonder and admiration for these precious stones. There are no other objects or characters present, focusing entirely on the beauty and allure of the diamonds themselves. The camera remains static throughout, allowing the viewer to fully appreciate the intricate details and the dynamic interplay of light and shadow on each gemstone.
caption: The video showcases a field of cut gemstones—round brilliants, ovals, marquise and pear shapes—suspended against a pure black void, denser along the left and right edges with a sparser middle. Throughout the excerpt the stones translate steadily downward, so those near the top edge glide toward the center while those at the bottom drift out of frame and fresh stones enter from above. Individual gems rotate and tumble as they descend, shifting their internal facet highlights and overall brightness, and a few stones in the center-left cluster fade toward near-black before brightening again as they turn. Star-shaped glints pulse on and off across several round brilliants, changing intensity between frames. A large central-bottom stone grows noticeably in apparent size as it descends, and several other stones likewise enlarge over the sequence, so this scaling is not confined to a single gem. Slight changes in relative spacing hint at mild depth differences. The rigid outlines of each gem remain undeformed throughout.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.

This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
